# Issue template requirements

Version: 0.2 | Updated: 2026-09-09 | Status: Draft specification

Planned forms: objective / product proposal, feature, bug, incident, autonomy failure, governance amendment, and agent improvement.

Every form needs an owner, acceptance criteria, evidence, dependencies, authority, and sensitivity guidance. Keep secrets and personal customer data out of public issues. Markdown specifications here do not register issue forms; implement supported forms during the GitHub automation phase.

## Change history

- 0.2 — 2026-09-09: Added to the blueprint-aligned foundation.
